title: Empty task creation causes HTTP 500

verifiedObservations.transport: Real HTTP via built-in Node.js fetch; 127.0.0.1 on an ephemeral port
verifiedObservations.storage: Fresh createApp() instance with private in-memory task storage

reproductionSteps: Run npm run reproduce:bug from the project root.
Start a fresh createApp() on 127.0.0.1 port 0; the OS assigns a free port.
POST /api/tasks with the fixed valid title; verify 201 and the created task.
POST /api/tasks with Content-Type application/json and the literal body {}.
POST /api/tasks without a body or Content-Type header (zero bytes).
Compare both actual statuses and sanitized errors with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR and the known 500 INTERNAL_ERROR signature.
Verify only the control task remains, check health, then close the temporary server.

analysis.basis: Source inspection, supported by the verified HTTP observations; no runtime stack trace was collected.

sourceLocations.relevance: JSON parsing, isolated service and /api/tasks mount
Empty inputs throw a generic Error before validateTaskInput
Undefined body and missing title already produce HttpError(400, VALIDATION_ERROR)
Non-HttpError exceptions map to sanitized 500 INTERNAL_ERROR
Existing expected contract; fixture actual values were not used as HTTP evidence
Asserts correct 400 behavior for both scenarios

analysis.rootCause: The create controller explicitly throws a generic Error for undefined bodies and empty objects before calling validateTaskInput. Express forwards this to errorHandler, which maps non-HttpError exceptions to HTTP 500 INTERNAL_ERROR. The existing validator would reject both inputs with HTTP 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.

recommendations.suggestedMinimalFix: After human approval, remove the intentional empty-input throw branch in controller.create and let validateTaskInput handle both cases. Remove the unused isObject import if it is no longer referenced. Preserve generic-error sanitization in errorHandler.
verificationRequirements: Both empty input scenarios must return 400 VALIDATION_ERROR after an approved fix.
The unchanged separate npm run test:bug regression must then pass.
Valid creation must remain 201; rejected requests must not create tasks.
Normal API, Switch bridge and smoke suites must pass.
Update the investigation acceptance policy only in the approved fixing phase: it currently requires the preserved bug.
recommendations.approval: Investigation only. No automatic patching; any future edit requires explicit human approval.
